title: Show HN: Mic Drop, a real-time multiplayer karaoke game
summary: Mic Drop is a real-time multiplayer karaoke game where players compete to guess songs fastest. The web-based game enables remote friends to enjoy karaoke-style entertainment together, featuring instant gameplay rounds with scoring.
problem_solved: Provides a fun social music game experience for remote friends who want to play karaoke together online.
why_valuable: Fills the gap for casual real-time multiplayer music entertainment in a simple browser-based format that requires no downloads.
